name: namecheap-domains
title: Namecheap Domains
description: Search for available domains with live Namecheap pricing, start a registration, and browse the domains in your Namecheap account
author: ricardodantas

preferences.name: apiUser
preferences.title: API User
preferences.description: Your Namecheap API username. This is usually the same as your account username.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Generated under Profile › Tools › Namecheap API Access.

preferences.name: userName
preferences.title: Username
preferences.description: Account username the commands run against. Leave blank to use the API User.

preferences.name: clientIp
preferences.title: Client IP
preferences.description: Sent as the ClientIp API parameter. Namecheap authorises the address your Mac actually connects from, so this cannot fix an 'Invalid request IP' error. Leave blank to detect it.

preferences.name: sandbox
preferences.title: Environment
preferences.label: Use the Namecheap Sandbox
preferences.description: Requests go to api.sandbox.namecheap.com. Sandbox is a separate account with its own whitelist, and its domains are not real.

commands.name: check-availability
commands.title: Check Domain Availability
commands.subtitle: Namecheap
commands.description: Check whether a domain or keyword is available, with Namecheap registration pricing

preferences.name: defaultTlds
preferences.title: Default TLDs
preferences.description: Comma-separated TLDs checked when you type a keyword without a dot.
preferences.default: com, net, org, io, dev, app, ai, co

commands.name: register-domain
commands.title: Register Domain
commands.subtitle: Namecheap
commands.description: Verify availability and price, then continue to Namecheap checkout

commands.name: list-domains
commands.title: My Domains
commands.subtitle: Namecheap
commands.description: Browse the domains in your Namecheap account and open their management pages

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
